components.label: Explanation
components.html:
Claude fixture: map a JSON answer

Exercises the result mapping. The service task asks Claude to triage the message below and reply in JSON, then routes fields out of that answer:

  • /urgency → doc:/urgency
  • /answer → doc:/answer
  • /reason → pv:reason

The two doc: targets show up on the case summary tab afterwards. A mapping that fails never fails the step — the reason lands in claudeMappingError, which the result screen also shows.

components.label: Message to triage (doc:/question)
components.defaultValue: There has been no hot water in the building since Friday and there are two small children living on the third floor. Nobody answers the service number.
